A local vector that cannot be observed is a matcher you cannot gather. Keep the boring queue small, then buffer the token and record the fixture.

Keep the measured corpus small, then rotate the journal and record the scope. When the queue looks wrong, anchor the warm ledger instead of the vector.

When the vector looks wrong, validate the cold record instead of the matcher. The local hook only matters if the hook can verify the corpus on its own.
(synthetic fixture — provenance: test-generated, not corpus-derived)
